policy.trusted: all available votes for the exact body are accepted
policy.frontier: uncertain or repeat-disagreement; never treated as safe seed
policy.negative: all available votes for the exact body are rejected; local negative evidence only
policy.unchecked: no human verdict in the imported audit
policy.rejectionScope: local context only; no global slider bound
policy.excludedReason: Phase-2 shoulder-joint metric is known invalid and must not enter retrieval or gating.
policy.headModel: deferred; not used by this solver architecture
policy.activeAuditCanonicalMerge: v0.8.29.1 merges the returned 32-case ACTIVE export: carryover unchecked nodes are reclassified in-place; boundary midpoints are added as new local audited nodes. No global slider bounds are inferred.
policy.solverCanonicalStature: exact Anny rest-mesh bounding-box stature; legacy measurement-stack stature is diagnostic only in Body Bank Solver 1.0
policy.solverLocalAcceptanceScore: controllable geometry only: stature + chest + waist + hip; weight/mass remains retrieval/diagnostic prior and cannot veto/approve a local step
policy.solverProofHoldout: v1.2 removes target body, complete family and near core-recipe neighbors (distance <= 0.16) from retrieval
policy.canonicalActiveMerge: All rated v0.8.29.4 ACTIVE bodies are canonical nodes. Exact-shape localStorage learning at or before this index timestamp is pruned on load; later votes still override locally.
policy.edgeSafety: Accepted solver endpoints do not certify interpolation edges; solver-generated graph hints remain edge-unaudited until intermediate validation.
